title: Heavenly Blueberry Muffins
description: Light, fluffy muffins crowned with a crisp crumble and bursting with juicy blueberries — built for quiet mornings and empty plates.

ingredients.notes: divided: 240g for Muffin Batter, 20g for Crumble Topping
divided: 90g for Muffin Batter, 10g for Crumble Topping

method.instruction: Preheat your oven to 175°C and line a 12-hole muffin tray with paper cases.
In a bowl, whisk together 160 ml full-cream milk and 2 large eggs. Gradually pour and whisk in 100 ml vegetable oil until the wet mixture is emulsified.
Add 90 g of white sugar to the wet mixture and stir until fully dissolved.
Sift in 240 g of plain flour, 30 g milk powder, and 9 g baking powder. Mix gently with a spatula until just combined — do not overmix, as some lumps are fine.

Prepare the crumble topping in a separate small bowl by rubbing the remaining 20 g plain flour, 10 g softened unsalted butter, and the remaining 10 g white sugar together with your fingertips until coarse, sandy crumbs form.
Spoon the muffin batter into the lined paper cases, filling each cavity about three-quarters full.
Scatter 150 g blueberries evenly over the top of the batter in each cup, then finish by sprinkling the prepared crumble topping over the berries.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the tops are golden brown and a skewer inserted into the centre of a muffin comes out clean. Cool in the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

notes.title: Light Muffins
notes.content: Mix the batter gently and stop as soon as it comes together — overmixing develops gluten and makes muffins tough.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Best eaten warm on the day, but excellent toasted lightly the next morning.
